Liz: Heads up — onboarding sage-mini-v2 weights are uploaded to gs://redwood-weights/sage-mini-v2/2026-03-18/. Quick smoke found a tokenizer edge with leading emoji + chat templates where BOS/EOS trimming drops the emoji cluster. Can someone sanity-check config? :eyes:
CI-Bot: artifact upload complete: sage-mini-v2/2026-03-18.tar.gz (sha256: 3f9a2c...).
Anand: What tokenizer backend are we using for this model — HF tokenizer.json or our internal fast-tokenizer? Also can you paste a minimal repro?
Liz: HF tokenizer.json (from model tar). Minimal repro below:
```python
from tokenizers import Tokenizer
tok = Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizer.json')
print(tok.encode('🙂 hi').tokens)
print(tok.encode(' hi').tokens)
```
Output I saw: `['', ' hi']` for the emoji case — looks like BOS gets consumed and emoji becomes part of first token.
Maria: Seen something like this — emoji + skin-tone or ZWJ clusters can be treated as multi-codepoint glyphs and confuse some byte-pair splits. If BOS trimming is on at inference, the first cluster can be swallowed.
Jeff: Which chat template are you testing with? Some of our templates add a system prompt that expects a literal BOS token. If the tokenizer rewrites the first token that can shift offsets.
Liz: Using the standard chat template: `[{"role":"system","content":"You are a helpful assistant."},{"role":"user","content":"🙂 Hello"}]`. Observed off-by-one in token offsets when streaming (responses start late).
Anand: Quick suggestion: try disabling automatic BOS trimming and set explicit special tokens in the config. E.g. in model config: `
{"tokenization": {
  "add_bos": true,
  "trim_bos_on_input": false,
  "preserve_leading_whitespace": true
}
}`
Maria: Also try HF API call to normalize unicode: `text = unicodedata.normalize('NFKC', text)` before tokenization — that can collapse some codepoint sequences into stable forms.
Jeff: Can we add a small unit/regression test in the serving repo to catch this? Suggest path: `tests/tokenizer/test_emoji_bos.py`. Minimal test:
```py
def test_emoji_bos_preserve(tokenizer):
    toks = tokenizer.encode('🙂 Hello')
    assert toks[0].text.startswith('') or toks[0].text == '🙂'
```
```
# (psuedo-example; keep it tight so CI is fast)
```
Liz: I'll add the test + a small normalization step in the pre-tokenize hook. Planning a PR in ~30m: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving/pull/XXXX (WIP).
CI-Bot: quick-check: model artifact checksum matched and passed schema validation for model card and tokenizer.json. No forbidden fields.
Liz: Ran a streaming smoke after toggling `trim_bos_on_input=false` — streaming start token aligned now, but still saw one case where combined ZWJ + flag emoji ended up merging; pushing unicode normalization fix too. Log snippet: `STREAM START offset=0 token="" -> ok; case emoji-cluster: offset shifted by 1`
Anand: :thumbsup: When you open the PR tag @Anand for review. Also add a short note in the model card (models registry) under `known_quirks` pointing to this thread and the recommended config flags.
Jeff: Add a changelog entry (internal) and a short bullet for docs where we list `preserve_leading_whitespace` and `unicode normalization` as mitigations.
Liz: Will do both. Assigning myself to the PR and test. Thanks all — will ping again when PR is green. :pray:
